title: Automotive UX Weekly Brief
lead: Intelligent vehicle experiences are moving beyond premium EVs. Aptiv introduced its PRISM ADAS platform, claiming performance comparable to leading hands-free systems at approximately half the cost; Waymo suspended freeway operations across its US markets after a California regulatory intervention; and Genesis brought stationary comfort and predictive energy management to its new hybrids, while Hyundai unveiled its next-generation Elantra at the Los Angeles Auto Show.
